label: bug
file: src/util/dates.ts

The weekly rollup send time is gated by `isRollupDue`, which checks `localHour(now, user.timezone)` correctly, but also computes `startOfWeek(now, user.timezone)`. That function ignores its `tz` parameter entirely (see the `// TODO: honour tz` comment) and derives the week start using UTC day-of-week/hour. For users ahead of UTC, like Sydney (UTC+10/11), the UTC calendar date can roll over a day later than their local date, shifting when the week boundary—and therefore the Monday send—lands, so the email goes out a day late. London users are close enough to UTC that this doesn't manifest. `startOfWeek` needs to compute the week start using the user's local time zone instead of UTC.
